118        /**

138         */

145        /**
146         *  Creates a new {@code BuilderImpl} instance.

149         *      builder instance.

151         *  @param  anonymousTypeArguments  Anonymous type arguments.
152         */
153        @SuppressWarnings( {"OptionalUsedAsFieldOrParameterType"} )
154        public BuilderImpl( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final JavaComposer composer, final Optional<String> name, @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final CodeBlockImpl anonymousTypeArguments )
155        {

163        /**
164         *  {@inheritDoc}
165         */
166        @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.2.0" )
167        @Override
168        public final BuilderImpl addAttribute( final FieldSpec fieldSpec, final boolean readOnly )
169        {
170            final var fieldSpecImpl = (FieldSpecImpl) requireValidNonNullArgument( fieldSpec, "fieldSpec", v -> v.hasModifier( PRIVATE ), (_,v) -> "Field %s needs to be private".formatted( v.name() ) );
171            addField( fieldSpecImpl );
172
173            final var fieldName = fieldSpecImpl.name();
174            final var propertyName = decapitalize( fieldName.startsWith( "m_" ) ? fieldName.substring( 2 )  : fieldName );
175
176            final Set<Modifier> modifiers = EnumSet.of( PUBLIC, FINAL );
177            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) modifiers.add( STATIC );
178
179            final var accessor = getFactory().methodBuilder( propertyName )
180                .addModifiers( modifiers )
181                .returns( fieldSpecImpl.type() )
182                .addStatement( "return $N", fieldSpecImpl )
183                .build();
184            addMethod( accessor );
185
186            if( !(readOnly || fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
187            {
188                final var param = getFactory().parameterBuilder( fieldSpecImpl.type(), "value", FINAL )
189                    .build();
190                final var setter = getFactory().methodBuilder( propertyName )
191                    .addModifiers( modifiers )
192                    .addParameter( param )
193                    .returns( VOID_PRIMITIVE )
194                    .addStatement( "$N = $N", fieldSpecImpl, param )
195                    .build();
196                addMethod( setter );
197            }
198
199            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
200            return this;
201        }   //  addAttribute()
202
203        /**
204         *  {@inheritDoc}
205         */
206        @Override
207        public final BuilderImpl addMethod( final MethodSpec methodSpec )
208        {
209            final var methodSpecImpl = (MethodSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( methodSpec, "methodSpec" );
210            checkState( methodSpecImpl.defaultValue().isEmpty(), () -> new IllegalStateException( "%s %s.%s cannot have a default value".formatted( CLASS, getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ), methodSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
211            checkState( !methodSpecImpl.hasModifier( DEFAULT ), () -> new IllegalStateException( "%s %s.%s cannot be default".formatted( CLASS, getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ), methodSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
212
213            final var methodSpecs = getMethodSpecs();
214            if( composer().addDebugOutput() )
215            {
216                final var builder = methodSpecImpl.toBuilder( false );
217                createDebugOutput( true ).ifPresent( debug -> builder.addJavadoc( "\n$L\n", debug.asLiteral() ) );
218                methodSpecs.add( builder.build() );
219            }
220            else
221            {
222                methodSpecs.add( methodSpecImpl );
223            }
224
225            final var maxMethods = composer().getMaxMethods();
226            if( (maxMethods > 0) && (methodSpecs.size() >= maxMethods) )
227            {
228                addSuppressableWarning( CLASS_WITH_TOO_MANY_METHODS );
229            }
230
231            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
232            return this;
233        }   //  addMethod()
234
235        /**
236         *  {@inheritDoc}
237         */
238        @Override
239        public final Builder addProperty( final FieldSpec fieldSpec, final boolean readOnly )
240        {
241            final var fieldSpecImpl = (FieldSpecImpl) requireValidNonNullArgument( fieldSpec, "fieldSpec", v -> v.hasModifier( PRIVATE ), (_,v) -> "Field %s needs to be private".formatted( v.name() ) );
242            addField( fieldSpecImpl );
243
244            final var fieldName = fieldSpecImpl.name();
245            final var propertyName = fieldName.startsWith( "m_" ) ? fieldName.substring( 2 ) : capitalize( fieldName );
246
247            final Set<Modifier> modifiers = EnumSet.of( PUBLIC, FINAL );
248            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) modifiers.add( STATIC );
249
250            final var getter = getFactory().methodBuilder( "get" + propertyName )
251                .addModifiers( modifiers )
252                .returns( fieldSpecImpl.type() )
253                .addStatement( "return $N", fieldSpecImpl )
254                .build();
255            addMethod( getter );
256
257            if( !(readOnly || fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
258            {
259                final var param = getFactory().parameterBuilder( fieldSpecImpl.type(), "value", FINAL )
260                    .build();
261                final var setter = getFactory().methodBuilder( "set" + propertyName )
262                    .addModifiers( modifiers )
263                    .addParameter( param )
264                    .returns( VOID_PRIMITIVE )
265                    .addStatement( "$N = $N", fieldSpecImpl, param )
266                    .build();
267                addMethod( setter );
268            }
269
270            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
271            return this;
272        }   //  addProperty()
273
274        /**
275         *  {@inheritDoc}
276         */
277        @Override
278        public final ClassSpecImpl build()
279        {
280            final var isAbstract = getModifiers().contains( ABSTRACT );
281
282            for( final var methodSpec : getMethodSpecs() )
283            {
284                checkState( isAbstract || !methodSpec.hasModifier( ABSTRACT ), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "non-abstract type %s cannot declare abstract method %s".formatted( getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ), methodSpec.name() ) ) );
285            }
286
287            final var superclassIsObject = getSuperclass().equals( OBJECT );
288            final var interestingSupertypeCount = (superclassIsObject ? 0 : 1) + getSuperinterfaces().size();
289            checkState( getAnonymousTypeArguments().isEmpty() || interestingSupertypeCount <= 1, () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "anonymous type has too many supertypes" ) );
290
291            final var retValue = new ClassSpecImpl( this );
292
293            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
294            return retValue;
295        }   //  build()
296
297        /**
298         *  {@inheritDoc}
299         */
300        @Override
301        protected final Optional<CodeBlockImpl> getAnonymousTypeArguments() { return Optional.ofNullable( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ); }
302
303        /**
304         *  {@inheritDoc}
305         */
306        @Override
307        public final boolean isAnonymousClass() { return nonNull( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ); }
308
309        /**
310         *  {@inheritDoc}
311         */
312        @Override
313        public final BuilderImpl superclass( final TypeName superclass )
314        {
315            super.superclass( superclass );
316
317            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
318            return this;
319        }   //  superclass()
320    }

347    /**
348     *  Creates a dummy type spec for type-resolution in CodeWriter only while
349     *  emitting the type declaration but before entering the type body.
350     *
351     *  @param  type    The source type.
352     */
353    @SuppressWarnings( {"UseOfConcreteClass"} )
354    private ClassSpecImpl( final ClassSpecImpl type )
355    {
356        super( type );
357        assert isNull( type.m_AnonymousTypeArguments ) : "Not for anonymous classes";
358        m_AnonymousTypeArguments = type.m_AnonymousTypeArguments;
359    }   //  ClassSpecImpl()

362    ====** Methods **==========================================================
363        \*---------*/
364    /**
365     *  {@inheritDoc}

368    public final Optional<CodeBlock> anonymousTypeArguments()
369    {
370        return Optional.ofNullable( m_AnonymousTypeArguments );
371    }   //  anonymousTypeArguments()

373    /**
374     *  {@inheritDoc}
375     */
376    @Override
377    protected final TypeSpecImpl createCopy() { return new ClassSpecImpl( this ); }
378
379    /**
380     *  Emits the type to the given code writer, using the layout as defined
381     *  by the Foundation library code.
382     *
383     *  @param  codeWriter  The target code writer.
384     *  @param  enumName    The name of the enum; can be {@null}.
385     *  @param  implicitModifiers   The implicit modifiers.
386     *  @throws UncheckedIOException A problem occurred when writing to the
387     *      output target.
388     */
389    @SuppressWarnings( {"BoundedWildcard", "OptionalGetWithoutIsPresent", "MethodWithMultipleReturnPoints", "OverlyLongMethod", "OverlyComplexMethod"} )
390    @Override
391    protected final void emit4Foundation( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final CodeWriter codeWriter, final String enumName, final Set<Modifier> implicitModifiers ) throws UncheckedIOException
392    {
393        if( isNotEmptyOrBlank( enumName ) )
394        {
395            //---* Emit an enum constant *-------------------------------------
396            /*
397             * enum constants are implemented as anonymous types so this is
398             * called from an outer type spec.
399             */
400            codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
401            final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
402            getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
403                .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
404                .ifPresent( annotations::add );
405            codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
406            codeWriter.emit( "$L", enumName );
407            if( !m_AnonymousTypeArguments.formatParts().isEmpty() )
408            {
409                codeWriter.emit( "( " );
410                codeWriter.emit( m_AnonymousTypeArguments );
411                codeWriter.emit( " )" );
412            }
413
414            if( getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() && getMethodSpecs().isEmpty() && innerClasses().isEmpty() )
415            {
416                //---* Avoid unnecessary braces "{}" *-------------------------
417                return;
418            }
419
420            codeWriter.emit(
421                """
422
423                {
424                """ );
425        }
426        else if( nonNull( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ) )
427        {
428            //---* Emit an anonymous type that is not an enum constant *-------
429            final var supertype = getSuperInterfaces().isEmpty() ? getSuperClass() : getSuperInterfaces().getFirst();
430
431            codeWriter.emit( "new $T( ", supertype );
432            codeWriter.emit( m_AnonymousTypeArguments );
433            codeWriter.emit( """
434                 )
435                {
436                """ );
437        }
438        else
439        {
440            /*
441             * Push an empty type (specifically without nested types) for
442             * type-resolution.
443             */
444            codeWriter.pushType( createCopy() );
445
446            codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
447            final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
448            getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
449                .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
450                .ifPresent( annotations::add );
451            codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
452            codeWriter.emitModifiers( modifiers(), union( implicitModifiers, CLASS.asMemberModifiers() ) );
453            codeWriter.emit( "$L $L", CLASS.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), name().get() );
454            codeWriter.emitTypeVariables( getTypeVariables() );
455
456            final List<TypeNameImpl> extendsTypes = getSuperClass().equals( OBJECT ) ? List.of() : List.of( getSuperClass() );
457            final var implementsTypes = getSuperInterfaces();
458
459            if( !extendsTypes.isEmpty() )
460            {
461                codeWriter.emit( " extends" );
462                var firstType = true;
463                for( final var type : extendsTypes )
464                {
465                    if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
466                    codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
467                    firstType = false;
468                }
469            }
470
471            if( !implementsTypes.isEmpty() )
472            {
473                codeWriter.emit( " implements" );
474                var firstType = true;
475                for( final var type : implementsTypes )
476                {
477                    if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
478                    codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
479                    firstType = false;
480                }
481            }
482
483            codeWriter.popType();
484
485            codeWriter.emit(
486                """
487
488                {
489                """ );
490        }
491
492        codeWriter.pushType( this );
493
494        //---* Emit the class body *-------------------------------------------
495        codeWriter.indent();
496        var firstMember = true;
497
498        //---* Emit the inner types *------------------------------------------
499        if( !innerClasses().isEmpty() )
500        {
501            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
502            codeWriter.emit(
503                """
504                    /*---------------*\\
505                ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
506                    \\*---------------*/""" );
507            innerClasses().stream()
508                .sorted( comparing( t -> t.name().get(), CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
509                .map( t -> (TypeSpecImpl) t)
510                .forEachOrdered( t ->
511                {
512                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
513                    t.emit( codeWriter, null, CLASS.implicitTypeModifiers() );
514                } );
515            firstMember = false;
516        }
517
518        //--- Constants and attributes *---------------------------------------
519        if( !getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() )
520        {
521            final Collection<FieldSpecImpl> alreadyHandled = new HashSet<>();
522
523            //---* Emit the constants *----------------------------------------
524            final var constants = getFieldSpecs().stream()
525                .filter( fieldSpec -> fieldSpec.hasModifier( PUBLIC ) )
526                .filter( fieldSpec -> fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) )
527                .filter( fieldSpec -> fieldSpec.hasModifier( FINAL ) )
528                .filter( FieldSpecImpl::hasInitializer )
529                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
530                .toList();
531
532            if( !constants.isEmpty() )
533            {
534                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
535                codeWriter.emit(
536                    """    
537                        /*-----------*\\
538                    ====** Constants **========================================================
539                        \\*-----------*/""" );
540                constants.forEach( constantSpec ->
541                {
542                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
543                    constantSpec.emit( codeWriter, CLASS.implicitFieldModifiers() );
544                    alreadyHandled.add( constantSpec );
545                } );
546                firstMember = false;
547            }
548
549            //---* Emit the attributes *---------------------------------------
550            final var attributes = getFieldSpecs().stream()
551                .filter( fieldSpec -> !alreadyHandled.contains( fieldSpec ) )
552                .filter( fieldSpec -> !(fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) && fieldSpec.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
553                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
554                .toList();
555
556            if( !attributes.isEmpty() )
557            {
558                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
559                codeWriter.emit(
560                    """
561                        /*------------*\\
562                    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
563                        \\*------------*/""" );
564
565                attributes.forEach( a ->
566                {
567                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
568                    a.emit( codeWriter, CLASS.implicitFieldModifiers() );
569                    alreadyHandled.add( a );
570                } );
571                firstMember = false;
572            }
573
574            //---* Static fields *---------------------------------------------
575            final var statics = getFieldSpecs().stream()
576                .filter( staticSpec -> !alreadyHandled.contains( staticSpec ) )
577                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
578                .toList();
579            if( !statics.isEmpty() || !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
580            {
581                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
582                codeWriter.emit(
583                    """
584                        /*------------------------*\\
585                    ====** Static Initialisations **===========================================
586                        \\*------------------------*/""" );
587
588                statics.forEach( staticSpec ->
589                {
590                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
591                    staticSpec.emit( codeWriter, CLASS.implicitFieldModifiers() );
592                    alreadyHandled.add( staticSpec );
593                } );
594
595                //---* Static Block *------------------------------------------
596                if( !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
597                {
598                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
599                    codeWriter.emit( getStaticBlock() );
600                }
601                firstMember = false;
602            }
603        }
604
605        //---* Constructors *--------------------------------------------------
606        final var constructors = getMethodSpecs().stream()
607            .filter( MethodSpecImpl::isConstructor )
608            .sorted( comparing( MethodSpecImpl::toString, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
609            .toList();
610        if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() || !constructors.isEmpty() )
611        {
612            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
613            codeWriter.emit(
614                """
615                    /*--------------*\\
616                ====** Constructors **=====================================================
617                    \\*--------------*/""" );
618
619            //---* Initializer block *-----------------------------------------
620            if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() )
621            {
622                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
623                codeWriter.emit( getInitializerBlock() );
624            }
625
626            //---* Emit the constructors *-------------------------------------
627            constructors.forEach( constructorSpec ->
628            {
629                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
630                constructorSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), CLASS.implicitMethodModifiers() );
631            } );
632            firstMember = false;
633        }
634
635        //---* Methods (static and non-static) *-------------------------------
636        final var methods = getMethodSpecs().stream()
637            .filter( methodSpec -> !methodSpec.isConstructor() )
638            .sorted( TypeSpecImpl::compareMethodSpecs )
639            .toList();
640        if( !methods.isEmpty() )
641        {
642            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
643            codeWriter.emit(
644                """
645                    /*---------*\\
646                ====** Methods **==========================================================
647                    \\*---------*/""" );
648
649            methods.forEach( methodSpec ->
650            {
651                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
652                methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), CLASS.implicitMethodModifiers() );
653            } );
654        }
655
656        codeWriter.unindent();
657        codeWriter.popType();
658
659        codeWriter.emit( "}" );
660        if( isEmpty( enumName ) && isNull( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ) )
661        {
662            codeWriter.emit( "\n//  $L $N", CLASS.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), this );
663
664            /*
665             * If this type isn't also a value, include a trailing newline.
666             */
667            codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
668        }
669    }   //  emit4Foundation()
670
671    /**
672     *  Emits the type to the given code writer, using the layout as defined
673     *  by the original JavaPoet code.
674     *
675     *  @param  codeWriter  The target code writer.
676     *  @param  enumName    The name of the enum; can be {@null}.
677     *  @param  implicitModifiers   The implicit modifiers.
678     *  @throws UncheckedIOException A problem occurred when writing to the
679     *      output target.
680     */
681    @SuppressWarnings( {"BoundedWildcard", "OptionalGetWithoutIsPresent", "MethodWithMultipleReturnPoints", "OverlyLongMethod", "OverlyComplexMethod"} )
682    @Override
683    protected final void emit4JavaPoet( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final CodeWriter codeWriter, final String enumName, final Set<Modifier> implicitModifiers ) throws UncheckedIOException
684    {
685        if( isNotEmptyOrBlank( enumName ) )
686        {
687            //---* Emit an enum constant *-------------------------------------
688            /*
689             * enum constants are implemented as anonymous types so this is
690             * called from an outer type spec.
691             */
692            codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
693            final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
694            getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
695                .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
696                .ifPresent( annotations::add );
697            codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
698            codeWriter.emit( "$L", enumName );
699            if( !m_AnonymousTypeArguments.formatParts().isEmpty() )
700            {
701                codeWriter.emit( "(" );
702                codeWriter.emit( m_AnonymousTypeArguments );
703                codeWriter.emit( ")" );
704            }
705
706            if( getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() && getMethodSpecs().isEmpty() && innerClasses().isEmpty() )
707            {
708                //---* Avoid unnecessary braces "{}" *-------------------------
709                return;
710            }
711
712            codeWriter.emit( " {\n" );
713        }
714        else if( nonNull( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ) )
715        {
716            //---* Emit an anonymous type that is not an enum constant *-------
717            final var supertype = getSuperInterfaces().isEmpty() ? getSuperClass() : getSuperInterfaces().getFirst();
718
719            codeWriter.emit( "new $T(", supertype );
720            codeWriter.emit( m_AnonymousTypeArguments );
721            codeWriter.emit( ") {\n" );
722        }
723        else
724        {
725            /*
726             * Push an empty type (specifically without nested types) for
727             * type-resolution.
728             */
729            codeWriter.pushType( createCopy() );
730
731            codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
732            final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
733            getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
734                .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
735                .ifPresent( annotations::add );
736            codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
737            codeWriter.emitModifiers( modifiers(), union( implicitModifiers, CLASS.asMemberModifiers() ) );
738            codeWriter.emit( "$L $L", CLASS.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), name().get() );
739            codeWriter.emitTypeVariables( getTypeVariables() );
740
741            final List<TypeNameImpl> extendsTypes = getSuperClass().equals( OBJECT ) ? List.of() : List.of( getSuperClass() );
742            final var implementsTypes = getSuperInterfaces();
743
744            if( !extendsTypes.isEmpty() )
745            {
746                codeWriter.emit( " extends" );
747                var firstType = true;
748                for( final var type : extendsTypes )
749                {
750                    if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
751                    codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
752                    firstType = false;
753                }
754            }
755
756            if( !implementsTypes.isEmpty() )
757            {
758                codeWriter.emit( " implements" );
759                var firstType = true;
760                for( final var type : implementsTypes )
761                {
762                    if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
763                    codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
764                    firstType = false;
765                }
766            }
767
768            codeWriter.popType();
769
770            codeWriter.emit( " {\n" );
771        }
772
773        codeWriter.pushType( this );
774
775        //---* Emit the class body *-------------------------------------------
776        codeWriter.indent();
777        var firstMember = true;
778
779        //---* Static fields *-------------------------------------------------
780        for( final var fieldSpec : getFieldSpecs() )
781        {
782            if( !fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) continue;
783            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
784            fieldSpec.emit( codeWriter, CLASS.implicitFieldModifiers() );
785            firstMember = false;
786        }
787
788        if( !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
789        {
790            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
791            codeWriter.emit( getStaticBlock() );
792            firstMember = false;
793        }
794
795        //--* Non-static fields *----------------------------------------------
796        for( final var fieldSpec : getFieldSpecs() )
797        {
798            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) continue;
799            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
800            fieldSpec.emit( codeWriter, CLASS.implicitFieldModifiers() );
801            firstMember = false;
802        }
803
804        //---* Initializer block *---------------------------------------------
805        if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() )
806        {
807            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
808            codeWriter.emit( getInitializerBlock() );
809            firstMember = false;
810        }
811
812        //---* Constructors *--------------------------------------------------
813        for( final var methodSpec : getMethodSpecs() )
814        {
815            if( !methodSpec.isConstructor() ) continue;
816            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
817            methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), CLASS.implicitMethodModifiers() );
818            firstMember = false;
819        }
820
821        //---* Methods (static and non-static) *-------------------------------
822        for( final var methodSpec : getMethodSpecs() )
823        {
824            if( methodSpec.isConstructor() ) continue;
825            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
826            methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), CLASS.implicitMethodModifiers() );
827            firstMember = false;
828        }
829
830        //---* Types (inner classes) *-----------------------------------------
831        for( final var typeSpec : innerClasses() )
832        {
833            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
834            ((TypeSpecImpl) typeSpec).emit( codeWriter, null, CLASS.implicitTypeModifiers() );
835            firstMember = false;
836        }
837
838        codeWriter.unindent();
839        codeWriter.popType();
840
841        codeWriter.emit( "}" );
842        if( isEmpty( enumName ) && isNull( m_AnonymousTypeArguments ) )
843        {
844            /*
845             * If this type isn't also a value, include a trailing newline.
846             */
847            codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
848        }
849    }   //  emit4JavaPoet()
850
851    /**
852     *  {@inheritDoc}
853     */
854    @Override
855    public final boolean equals( final Object o )
856    {
857        var retValue = this == o;
858        if( !retValue && (o instanceof final ClassSpecImpl other) )
859        {
860            retValue = getFactory().equals( other.getFactory() ) && toString().equals( o.toString() );
861        }
862
863        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
864        return retValue;
865    }   //  equals()
866
867    /**
868     *  {@inheritDoc}
869     */
870    @Override
871    public final int hashCode() { return hash( getFactory(), toString() ); }
872
873    /**
874     *  {@inheritDoc}
875     */
876    @Override
877    public final TypeSpecImpl.BuilderImpl toBuilder()
878    {
879        final var retValue = new BuilderImpl( getFactory(), name(), (CodeBlockImpl) anonymousTypeArguments().orElse( null ) );
880        retValue.getJavadoc().addWithoutDebugInfo( getJavadoc() );
881        retValue.getAnnotations().addAll( getAnnotations() );
882        retValue.getModifiers().addAll( modifiers() );
883        retValue.getTypeVariables().addAll( getTypeVariables() );
884        retValue.superclass( getSuperClass() );
885        retValue.getSuperinterfaces().addAll( getSuperInterfaces() );
886        retValue.getFieldSpecs().addAll( getFieldSpecs() );
887        retValue.getMethodSpecs().addAll( getMethodSpecs() );
888        retValue.getTypeSpecs().addAll( typeSpecs() );
889        retValue.getInitializerBlock().addWithoutDebugInfo( getInitializerBlock() );
890        retValue.getStaticBlock().addWithoutDebugInfo( getStaticBlock() );
891        retValue.getStaticImports().addAll( getStaticImports() );
892        retValue.addSuppressableWarning( getSuppressableWarnings().toArray( SuppressableWarnings []::new ) );
893
894        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
895        return retValue;
896    }   //  toBuilder()
897}
898//  class ClassSpecImpl
